name: relation.add
title: Create relation
summary: Add a relation; stores target UUID and current version, plus the title only within the same repository. A relation over a limit of the kind is saved too, with a relation.too-many hint.
whileReadOnlyReason: Writes the current version of the target, which depends on the metamodel (which properties count).

source.description: The element whose file gets the relation.

kind.description: The relation kind: its key in the metamodel.

target.description: The element the relation points to.

files.description: Written files, relative to the workspace root.
